metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. Readers are analysis-only, fit on W's fixed top-scale pool with the SAME seed as W, tuned on the fixed canonical VAL, evaluated once on the untouched canonical TEST. The ONLY factor is optimizer_updates in {200,1000}; selection is VAL-only; no TEST-based selection.

primary_decision.rule_note: X-A if some reader at L4/full has 1000-budget test>=0.50 AND held-out>=0.30; X-B if every reader's best 1000-budget test<=0.25 AND held-out<=0.25 AND training accuracy <0.50 (still low); else inconclusive/partial. Bars are declared conventions; continuous values reported.
